_comment: Feature flags, one entry per surface: {"flag-name": {"stage": bool, "prod": bool}}. Every new surface ships behind one, off in BOTH environments, until a human turns it on. The ladder's rung 5 writes this file when a change is signed off, so the shape is a contract, not a preference — see src/lib/flags.ts and tests/flags.test.ts. Keys starting with an underscore are notes, not flags.
